item.title: Operation
item.description:
Operating Modes

The EH Locator operates in two modes, configurable via Haltian Field.

Router Mode

In router mode, the EH Locator actively participates in the Wirepas mesh network:

  • Receives and transmits BLE messages from asset tags and other routers
  • Transmits beacon messages every second (configurable) for positioning
  • Requires USB-C or sufficient light harvesting for continuous operation
  • Can operate up to 10 days on battery alone during power outages

item.title: Installation
item.description:
Installation Overview

The Haltian EH Locator offers flexible installation options to suit various environments. This guide covers three primary mounting methods:

  1. Indoor Light Mount - Attach to ceiling light fixtures using energy harvesting
  2. Cable Shelf Mount - Mount on cable management or ceiling infrastructure with USB-C power
  3. Wall Mount - Install on walls at recommended height with USB-C power
Before Installation

Ensure the Haltian IoT Gateway is operational and connected before installing EH Locators. Locators require an active Wirepas mesh network to function properly.

item.title: Troubleshooting
item.description:
Power LED Issues

Power LED off or blinking (indoor light harvesting)

  • Measure lux levels at installation height
  • Relocate to a brighter area (closer to light source)
  • Switch to USB-C power if light is insufficient
  • Check that solar panel is not blocked or obstructed

Power LED off when using USB-C

  • Verify USB-C cable is fully inserted
  • Test power adapter with another device
  • Check power outlet functionality
  • Try a different USB-C cable
  • Verify the power switch is in the ON position
